summary: For outbound-only connections to controllers, set peers=automationcontroller in [execution_nodes:vars] so the execution nodes open the connection to the control plane.
questions: How do I make execution nodes connect to the controller?
Automation mesh with only outbound connections to controller
Firewall blocks inbound connections to controller nodes

answer_card.title: Outbound-only connections to controllers
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationcontroller]
controller-[1:2].example.com

[execution_nodes]
execution-[1:5].example.com

[execution_nodes:vars]
# connection is established from the execution nodes to the controllers
peers=automationcontroller
```
